title: GPOM Second Half B: Maddie at the Door
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half B: Maddie at the door
about: Cut 3 of the GPOM second half, split in two (Kai, round 2 Q5). Built by scripts/gpom/second-half-video/cut3.py B (round 2, 23 Oct 2026: Kai's beat-17 words from script.json, voiced by voice3.py --round B2 into voices.json); notes and plan in cut-notes.json, shots in ../second-half-cut3-shots.md.

beats.name: Maddie at the door
beats.blurb: Maddie rolls up to the shut bunker door and settles. No wrecks, no smoke.

beats.name: The tannoy
beats.blurb: Maddie's voice on the tannoy over Sandra and Derek mid-row (we never see the speaker). They stop dead. Cut to the crowd looking up.

beats.name: Hello
beats.blurb: Hard cut: the doors already open, Maddie waits just OUTSIDE on the threshold (the beat 17 doorway shot), the old lady's back in the foreground.

beats.name: The old lady and Maddie
beats.blurb: The old lady among the crowd; Maddie past her shoulder, outside the big doorway. Shot / reverse shot, then the argument: the time machine runs on them. 'Come back tomorrow.'

beats.name: Maddie turns away
beats.blurb: The door slams. Maddie rolls away from the shut bunker door, down the hill towards us and out of frame: the humans will have time. Hard cut to scene C.
